cascade: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new arm (harness, provider, tier) is described: its five ratings and reasons are a row of arm_ideas.csv beside the solution, rated before it is built] > offline [real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the harness's own tests pass with no model: test_headless_runner.py replays each harness's recorded event stream through a fake program (report, tokens, cost, launch failure, time limit, cancel, escalation), and the Claude Code runner tests pass; the none arm is the zero bound] > public [real=no | when=graded public evidence for the arm exists at grade C or better (public_priors.csv beside the solution)] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=the offline stage passed for the harness and the arm's provider has credentials where we measure: one real case runs end to end and its report is read by hand] > staged [sample=sample:6 | real=yes | gate=competitive | max-age-days=90 | when=the one case passed and a call budget is set with --max-calls: two cases of each kind] > whole [sample=full | real=yes | max-age-days=90 | when=the staged sample passed its gate, or did not separate the leading arms]
